player_prompt.intro:
Ningalliba Player {player_id} a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors khelliba.
Ningalliba goal ama round adom adomgi win taragagi.
Round adom adomgi, '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]' gi respond taragagi.
'[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' gi shorthand akha changsillagi.

message.round_win: Round gi result: {winner} ki khilangba jingalakpa!
